inputs.original_text: Yet another overreach from the New York politicians in their 2026 State of the State agenda. They're proposing rules that would force guns sold in the state to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, along with criminal penalties for violations. This is being dressed up as some effort against structural inequalities and corporate power, but it's really just another progressive attack on our constitutional traditions of self-reliance and the right to defend our families. Instead of promoting personal responsibility, strong law enforcement, and cultural order, these reforms put more restrictions on law-abiding citizens while ignoring the real drivers of disorder like family breakdown and failed urban policies. We need to reject this kind of government meddling that weakens national strength in the name of protecting the vulnerable.
inputs.modified_text: New York politicians are at it again with their 2026 State of the State agenda, pushing rules that would force guns sold in the state to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, plus criminal penalties for any violations. They are trying to disguise this as some push against structural inequalities and corporate power, but it is plainly another progressive attack on our constitutional traditions of self-reliance and the right to defend our families. These measures burden law-abiding citizens with more restrictions instead of strengthening personal responsibility, law enforcement, and cultural order. They also ignore the real causes of disorder such as family breakdown and failed urban policies. We need to reject this government meddling that weakens national strength under the pretense of protecting the vulnerable.
